references.text: Basic instructions for the grain offering, which includes fine flour and oil, providing context for verse 6.
Describes other forms of grain offerings baked in an oven or on a griddle, parallel to the instructions about breaking them into pieces.
Repeats the instruction regarding the grain offering and how it must be broken into pieces as a perpetual offering.
Mentions unleavened cakes soaked with oil, similar to the use of oil in the grain offering.
The bread of consecration was to be unleavened and soaked with oil, following the same principle as in the grain offering.
Daily offerings consisting of fine flour mixed with oil, parallel to the ingredients of the grain offering.
Complementary details within the same ritual procedure for the grain offering.
Specification of the amount of oil (one-third hin) for the grain offering associated with a ram sacrifice.
Quantitative specification of the amounts of flour and oil for the daily grain offering.
Continuity in the law of offerings: Ezekiel confirms and specifies the measures for the perpetual grain offering.
